reach_test: Second data point of the pre-registered Day-8 hashtag reach test (STATE x_lane.day8_lever_preregistered + decisions 2026-10-08 L2). 小ネタ⑤ (10/09) + ⑥ (10/10) carry the same 2 buyer-searched hashtags (#スプレッドシート #業務効率化); 小ネタ①-④ (median imp 10, un-tagged) are the control. The 2026-10-11 X trigger reads median imp of ⑤-⑥: if still <20 -> stop the 自動化の小ネタ tips series, keep only the daily 第2弾 Day N numbers post.
